meta.description:
Sony Pictures Animation produces animated entertainment for audiences around the world. The studio is currently in production on "Spider-Man™: Beyond the Spider-Verse," the highly-anticipated conclusion to the Spider-Verse trilogy, which began with 2018's Academy Award®-winning "Spider-Man™: Into the Spider-Verse."

The studio's upcoming features include "GOAT," an original animated sports comedy
